sections.title: Doubles
facts: Double the tens and the ones separately: double $34 = 60 + 8 = 68$.

sections.title: Near doubles
facts: $8 + 7$: double $8$ and one less, $15$ (or double $7$ and one more).

sections.title: Halves
facts: Halve the tens and the ones separately: half of $68 = 30 + 4 = 34$.
Half of an odd number of tens ends in $5$: half of $70$ is $35$.

sections.title: Double and halve
facts: Double one number and halve the other: the answer stays the same.
